scope: Cast consumer migration after owner acceptance of consistent playlist lengths. Compilation/source review only; no new automated or runtime/receiver checks.

builds.standaloneSound: BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 1m 2s; 35 tasks; audio-api/core assemble and audio-processing assembleDebug

convertedCallPaths: CastMediaServer HTTP GET/HEAD/ranges borrow common positional source views.
Receiver-native formats use the existing encoded whitelist and byte-slice policy, with source access through AudioPlaybackInput.
Other formats request library PcmOutputOptions(bitsPerSample=16,duplicateMono=true) and share AudioWaveSource across requests.
CastManager uses original track.fileName for receiver MIME selection, including archive entries.

resourcePolicy.sessionUrls: Track metadata retained for session lifetime; evicted prepared sources reopen on later requests.
resourcePolicy.preparationFailure: Entry removed so later requests can retry.
resourcePolicy.stop: Close sockets, interrupt workers/preparation, retire cache entries and release source/scratch owners.
resourcePolicy.clientExceptions: Contained by worker boundary, including socket-close failures.

libraryPolicy.retainedApi: Existing library signatures and default precision/channel behavior.
libraryPolicy.packing: 16-bit Cast output; duplicate mono; retain source rate and existing surround channel count.
libraryPolicy.unknownTotals: Full PCM disk preparation; no complete host encoded/PCM/WAV arrays.
libraryPolicy.fallback: Same output policy applied during recovery.

remainingAcceptance: Receiver-native and converted formats, including MIDI/NSF and archive/provider inputs.
Repeated ranges and seeks, old-URL reopening, stop/reconnect and preparation failure retry.
Regular local playback/seek/gapless confirmation after the additive output API.
limits: Receiver codec policy is unchanged; no new format support or resampling is claimed.
Transcoded CUE time-slice limitations remain; encoded byte slices retain the existing policy.
Legacy codec materialization limits, unknown-total PCM disk preparation and unsupported-source staging remain.
Source-provider timeouts govern already blocked reads; these builds are not runtime/latency verification.
